title: Shards of Earth
author: Adrian Tchaikovsky
summary: After humanity survived an alien extermination thanks to enhanced soldiers, a salvage crew finds one of them and gets entangled in politics. The war's terrible aliens may be returning.
readIf: you like crewed spaceships, alien menace and big-scale space opera.
skipIf: you want a self-contained book, since the story builds across a trilogy.
